subject.title: [Feature]: Inline agent widgets in web chat via client-capability-gated tools

question: Should OpenClaw accept `requiredClientCaps` as a plugin-visible tool API and ship Canvas `show_widget` as the bundled web-chat inline widget surface once the linked PR's mechanical blockers are resolved?
rationale: The request creates both a product/API contract and a model-authored scripted HTML/SVG sandbox surface; automation can inspect code paths, but cannot safely decide the permanent API and security boundary.

options.title: Review The Linked Implementation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate path, requiring repaired blockers plus explicit acceptance of the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

options.title: Redesign The Capability API First
options.body: Keep this issue open but pause the PR until maintainers choose a narrower or different client-capability contract.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widget Support
options.body: Close or pause the implementation path and keep widget experiments external until a missing core/plugin API is proven and approved.

recommendation.title: Review The Linked Implementation
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101840 as the candidate path, requiring repaired blockers plus explicit acceptance of the API and sandbox boundary before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the open implementation candidate and is the strongest visible routing signal for the requested API/security direction.
